verdict.rationale: Community users confirm that custom node development exists and that new integrations 'can be built easily' [n8n-comm-15, n8n-comm-12]. First-party evidence only covers in-workflow code (JavaScript, Python, npm packages) [n8n-gh-1, n8n-gh-6], and one user says the custom node development documentation 'leaves a lot to be desired' [n8n-comm-12]. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a node/connector SDK or developer platform, a CLI for scaffolding and building connectors (the documented CLI is for hosting), a private connector distribution or publishing workflow, and evidence of strong custom-node docs.
